summary: Merged family-and-Circles prototype passed 20 real Firestore emulator tests, a deployment dry-run, rules deployment and exact active-release read-back. This is not an exhaustive production security sign-off.

findings.issue: Existing family permissions were preserved exactly. They enforce account ownership but do not validate heterogeneous private document schemas.
findings.recommendation: Harden private schemas separately after analysing all existing record shapes, without breaking compatibility.

findings.issue: All authenticated accounts can read circle metadata; names and descriptions must not contain private family information.
findings.recommendation: Make visibility clear in the UI and keep sensitive details in member-only event documents.

findings.issue: Exact feed queries, private indexing, atomic invitation acceptance and removal/rejoining passed emulator checks. Browser interaction with two real signed-in accounts remains unverified.
findings.recommendation: Complete a two-adult-account walkthrough before inviting parents to use the app more broadly.
